messages.subject: For Benoit Bazin | Sustainable construction, government relations and emerging-market strategy
messages.body:
Dear Saint-Gobain Shareholder Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Benoit Bazin, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer.

Saint-Gobain's sustainable-construction and industrial-transformation agenda increasingly sits at the intersection of public policy, energy efficiency, sustainability and growth markets. Those priorities align strongly with my current mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I also support stakeholder governance around a major industrial renewable-energy platform and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, ESG and emerging-market stakeholder strategy might support Saint-Gobain's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Saint-Gobain.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
